question: Does the temporally supported L0 structure retain skill when TN from a Reach, terminal tree, or the naturally added 2021 stations is excluded from fitting?

folds.LORO: for every T1/T2/T3 evaluation Reach, remove that Reach from fold training TN and refit all seven global parameters
folds.LOTO: for every T1/T2/T3 evaluation terminal tree, remove that tree from fold training TN and refit all seven global parameters
folds.NATURAL_EXPANSION_2021: fit 2016-2020 established stations and evaluate stations first observed in 2021

optimizer.temporal_parent: reuse the locked Stage 28 fold solution only as a numerical start
optimizer.LORO_LOTO: one warm start followed by 35-step strong-Wolfe L-BFGS, matching the frozen parent spatial protocol
optimizer.natural_expansion: two registered starts, 120 AdamW plus 60 strong-Wolfe L-BFGS

benchmarks.station_blind_constant: within each fold, mean of training-station mean log1p(TN); every training station has equal weight
benchmarks.noninferiority: paired block bootstrap CI95 upper of delta log-RMSE < 0.005
benchmarks.positive_skill: paired block bootstrap CI95 lower of 1-SSE_L0/SSE_station_blind > 0

scientific_gate: LORO and LOTO must both be noninferior to OLD36 and have positive station-blind skill; natural expansion is a required reported stress test but does not alone define 230-Reach support
p2_contract: P2 may use only a test station's training-period history. Consequently P2 must equal P1 for every fully held-out Reach/tree and every first-observed-2021 station.
tree_163: mandatory separate open-lake-center domain boundary audit; excluded from formal river LORO/LOTO and model selection
boundary_contract: v_f=0 is a legal nested result. Other parameter boundaries in at most 5 percent of folds are reported as localized; more than 5 percent is spatial_fit_boundary_confounded.
forbidden: station, Reach or tree identity in P1
using held-out TN to fit parameters or choose a starting value
P2 correction for a station absent from training
new data, new k_L values, temperature, WWTP, SAS or hydrology refit
